from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, DropdownInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema import Data

from review_core.reporting import (
    artifact_metadata,
    build_html_report,
    build_json_report,
    build_pdf_report,
)


class DecisionReportExporter(Component):
    display_name = "Decision Report Exporter"
    description = "Export a synthetic, human-decided review as JSON, HTML, or PDF."
    icon = "file-down"
    name = "DecisionReportExporter"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="decision", display_name="Decision Snapshot", required=False),
        MultilineInput(
            name="decision_json",
            display_name="Decision JSON",
            value=(
                '{"case_id":"RC-DEMO","title":"Synthetic review",'
                '"document_hash":"demo","risk_score":18,"risk_level":"low",'
                '"decision":"approved","decision_reason":"Synthetic demo approval",'
                '"findings":[]}'
            ),
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="report_format",
            display_name="Format",
            options=["json", "html", "pdf"],
            value="pdf",
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="output_directory",
            display_name="Output Directory",
            value="/app/artifacts",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(name="artifact", display_name="Report Artifact", method="export")]

    def export(self) -> Data:
        payload = dict(self.decision.data) if self.decision else json.loads(self.decision_json)
        if payload.get("decision") not in {"approved", "rejected", "changes_requested"}:
            raise ValueError("A recorded human decision is required before report export")
        case_id = str(payload.get("case_id", "synthetic-case"))
        if self.report_format == "json":
            content = build_json_report(payload)
        elif self.report_format == "html":
            content = build_html_report(payload).encode("utf-8")
        else:
            content = build_pdf_report(payload)
        directory = Path(self.output_directory).resolve()
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination = (directory / f"{case_id}-report.{self.report_format}").resolve()
        if directory not in destination.parents:
            raise ValueError("Report destination escapes the configured artifact directory")
        destination.write_bytes(content)
        result = {
            "case_id": case_id,
            "format": self.report_format,
            "path": str(destination),
            **artifact_metadata(content),
            "data_classification": "SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ONLY",
        }
        self.status = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)
        return Data(data=result)
